# Apertures: where a declared rule can silently do the wrong thing

**Generated by `node tools/knowledge/apertures.mjs --write` — do not edit this file.**
The numbers come from the scanner; the classification lives in `APERTURES` in that script.
Pattern taken from `adva/docs/maintenance/FLOAT_APERTURES.md` + `scripts/float_aperture_scan.py`.

Corpus scanned: 77 works, 81575 passages.

| id | aperture | state | measured
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | **Entity spans are unquoted runs** — The reporting frames delimit their entity slots with a declared character class, not with a syntactic boundary, so an agent span can begin with a particle or adverb. | open, bounded | agent spans refused by the admissibility rules: 4148 (22.67%) of read passages; recipient spans: 246 (1.34%) |
| A2 | **A passage can hold several frames** — The grammar reads the most explicit frame and reports the rest as additionalMatches. | declared rule | passages holding more than one frame: 8955 (48.93%) |
| A3 | **Missing source pages** — A discovery route can point at pages that do not exist. | reported per work | 188 page(s) across 3 work(s) |
| A4 | **Duplicate section titles inside one work** — Source pages may give several poems the same `section` value; the disambiguating suffix exists only in the page name. | open | classic-of-poetry: 揚之水×3, 羔裘×3; 廣異記: 王老×2, 王乙×2, 蘇颋×2, 狄仁傑×2, 虎婦×2, 又×2, 李氏×3, 柳少遊×2 |
| A5 | **A title can lose the unit name** — Source headers disagree about where the unit goes; three 詩經 pages put the poem in `title` and the chapter in `section`. | closed by a gate | none |

ADMISSION still manual, because one character apart is equally consistent with a genuine difference between recensions. |

## What each one leaks

- **A1 Entity spans are unquoted runs**: A label taken from such a span asserts a false agent (`於是武王遍`, `厲聲`, `敖者`). The admissibility filter stops it being STORED; nothing stops the grammar from READING it.
- **A2 A passage can hold several frames**: A passage stating two relations yields one reading. The count is reported, so the answer does not pretend the passage had one frame — but the second relation is still dropped.
- **A3 Missing source pages**: The work builds SHORTER and reports success; the gap shows only in `limitations`.
- **A4 Duplicate section titles inside one work**: Two sections become indistinguishable by title (詩經 揚之水 ×3, 羔裘 ×3). Measured, not fixed — fixing it changes titles and no check yet distinguishes a legitimate repeat from a collision.
- **A5 A title can lose the unit name**: The section was named after the CHAPTER (國風‧邶 twice), so three poems looked absent while their text was present. Now repaired at discovery AND checked by tools/corpus/validate.mjs.
- **A6 Works with no licence template**: Corpus-derived evidence from those works carries CC BY-SA 4.0 (ShareAlike) rather than a public-domain rationale. Recorded per record; not a defect, but it constrains reuse.
- **A7 Variant character forms**: A search or a co-occurrence count for the conventional form misses those pages, and a quotation that differs by one character fails to match. Measured: of 435 citations not found in their cited work, 99 (23%) are ONE character away from text that does occur there, and the top candidates are the well-attested pairs (惟/維, 毋/無, 雝/雍, 昭/炤, 溥/普, 為/爲, 緜/緡). tools/intertext/variant-candidates.mjs proposes them with their witnesses; admission stays manual, because the same signal also produces non-variants — 醤→烕 is one, and it is recorded as the counter-example that justifies proposing rather than admitting. 2026-09-23 补：候选表**不是**变体表。罗小虎当日逐条判定：毋/無、緡/締、協/洽「本来就是不同字」，雍/雝 是**古今字**（「一个古字一个稍微现代」），普/溥 算**通假字**，維/惟「并非通常意义上的异体字关系」；他还给了总原则「异体、异文、通假等这么说比较准确，但其实要看具体文章」。据此重算：原先引用的 +44 里只有 **+12**（异体 7 + 古今字 5）是「同一个字的两种写法」，+10 是不同字、+2 是通假、**+20 未判定**（其中 惟→維 17 曾是本表自称“最高解释力”的候选）。knowledge/intertext/variants.json 现在**要求每对声明类别**，未判定的记为未判定且不计收益，tools/intertext/extract.mjs 对无类别或不可计数的条目直接报错。仍然未决：惟/維(17) 与 昭/烤(3) 待他裁定；於/于 是本项目自行归的「通用字」（18 条引用依赖它），已作为**问题**挂着，不冒充他的判断。类别随篇目与年代而变（「要看年代」），所以没有一劳永逸的全局表。
- **A8 A pin on a derived file drifts**: Any re-extraction rewrites the file and the digest moves even when the bound text is identical. Now reported as sourceDrift instead of failing, because the log is hash-chained and cannot be repaired by rewriting.
- **A9 A resemblance is not evidence until chance is measured**: any claim of the form "X looks like Y" — a number matching a constant, a ratio matching a target, a correspondence between two systems — must come with **what a random draw from the same search space achieves**. Worked example, measured in this session: 552 pairwise ratios among the session’s own numbers (81, 47, 34, 729, 423, 306, 211.5, 153, 365.5, 123, 369, 260, 64, 40, 36, 72, …) against 11 Feigenbaum-derived targets. The best match was **0.603%** relative error (306/123 ≈ α) — but 300 random trials of the SAME SIZE produced a **median** best error of **0.106%** and a 5% quantile of **0.001%**, so P(chance at least this close) ≈ **99.7%**: no signal. The lesson is the ratio, not the constant — **in a search space of a few hundred ratios against a few targets, a 0.6% coincidence is worthless; only ~0.001% would be worth chasing.** This aperture exists because the session took six resemblances as leads BEFORE any null was computed (五行 tables by co-occurrence; 613 as a digit match; 613 as a serial read as a count; the 22-shruti coverage; 陰陽 as the mechanism behind 47/48; 49−2 and 1/√3), and every one of them was later withdrawn by its own counterexample. **Not computing the null is not a discovery; it is a selection.**

## Not automatically measured

- **A7 variant characters** needs a character-variant table, which is a scholarly artefact this repository does not have. Two instances are known by hand: 女曰鷄鳴/雞鳴, 鳬鷖/鳧鷖.

## Non-claims

- An aperture is not a defect. Several entries were defects and are kept after repair because the repair has a measured cost (A1 filters labels, it does not stop the reading).
- This list is not exhaustive; it is the set that has been measured. A new one is added by editing `tools/knowledge/apertures.mjs`, not by appending prose here.
